## tattoo_flash_sheet

> Traditional tattoo flash sheet — multiple design vignettes on aged paper.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1280`, aspect `4:5`
**Demo vars:** `templates/tattoo/_vars_examples/tattoo_flash_sheet.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A traditional tattoo flash sheet for the fictional studio "House of Iris Tattoo", sheet number 07, dated 2026. The sheet holds 8 to 12 isolated tattoo design vignettes — single motifs in the old American traditional — daggers, swallows, roses family — arranged in a calm grid on aged paper. Each vignette is a self-contained drawing on white space, never overlapping another. No human body, no skin, no in-progress photography — only the inked designs sitting on the sheet.
[2. Action] The viewer reads the sheet like a menu: the eye scans across the grid, settling briefly on each vignette before moving on. The studio name, sheet number, and year sit as a small masthead so the sheet can be cataloged.
[3. Scene] Studio-flat document setting. The flash sheet is rendered as if photographed flat on a calm background, with a faint warm tea-stained or aged-paper texture. No environment, no hands, no shop interior — just the paper.
[4. Composition] Vertical 4:5 plate. A small masthead band at the top ~9% holds the studio name on the left and the sheet number / year on the right. Below the masthead, an irregular but balanced grid (roughly 3 columns x 3-4 rows) of isolated tattoo vignettes, each in its own breathing space, with no design crowding another. 6% safe margins on every edge. The sheet must read as a layout artifact, not a single illustration.
[5. Style] Traditional tattoo flash aesthetic — bold black ink line work, selective solid-fill, optional limited spot color (deep red, classic green, ochre) drawn from old American traditional / Japanese irezumi / dotwork lineages depending on old American traditional — daggers, swallows, roses. Aged paper, faint foxing at the edges, subtle pencil grid lines barely visible behind the ink. No photographic skin, no body context, no neon glow, no 3D.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- studio_name: "House of Iris Tattoo"
- sheet_no: "Sheet 07"
- year: "2026"

NO: human body, photographic skin, tattooing in progress, real famous shop logos, real famous artist signatures, rainbow gradients, 3D rendering, neon glow, photographic lighting, watermarks, lens flare, HDR oversaturation
```

## tattoo_minimal_design

> Single isolated minimalist tattoo design on stark white substrate.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1024`, aspect `1:1`
**Demo vars:** `templates/tattoo/_vars_examples/tattoo_minimal_design.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A single isolated minimalist tattoo design — "Mariner's Knot" — rendered as a self-contained drawing on a stark white substrate. Motif: single coiled rope ending in a small anchor. Style cue: single-needle minimal with light dot stipple. The design is the only object in the frame; there is no human body, no skin, no shop context, no in-progress photography. A small footer caption holds the design name.
[2. Action] The viewer's eye lands on the centered drawing, traces its contours and counter-spaces, and only then registers the small footer caption. The design must read as a finished line-art plate that could be transferred to a stencil unchanged.
[3. Scene] Studio-flat document setting. The substrate is a clean white paper with subtle tooth, calibrated for stencil-press output. No environment, no perspective, no shadow gimmicks; the page is the world.
[4. Composition] Square 1:1 frame. Design occupies the central ~52% area, perfectly centered with generous breathing space on every side. Bottom 8% safe band holds a single quiet centered caption with the design name. No grid, no decorative border, no other vignettes — this is a single-piece sheet.
[5. Style] Minimalist tattoo aesthetic — clean uniform line weight at 0.4 mm uniform fine line, no shading or only the slightest dot-stipple accent. Lineage: contemporary fine-line / single-needle / minimal dotwork (Dr Woo school, micro-tattoo lineage) without copying any real artist. Pure black ink on white. No color, no gradient, no 3D, no photographic rendering, no glow.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- design_name: "Mariner's Knot"

NO: human body, photographic skin, tattooing in progress, real famous artist signatures, real famous shop logos, rainbow gradients, 3D rendering, neon glow, photographic lighting, heavy color fill, watermarks, lens flare
```
